narrative: Constructed; maximal contrast (pale, organic, slow, anti-grid). Breathwork + somatic therapy for high-achievers in burnout. Speaks slowly, almost whispered; skeptical OF marketing. Clients are skeptical of woo — engineers, surgeons, founders — bodies in fight-or-flight. Resulting direction: a site that lowers your heart rate — bone-and-fog stillness, one breathing image, serif calm, evidence in the footnotes. Opposite of E3 entirely.

summary_for_practitioner: Your site is built to lower a heart rate: bone, fog, and river-stone tones, a quiet humanist serif that never towers, and a single hero image of light through linen that breathes on a slow four-second cycle — the one motion on the page, because it is literally the method. For the skeptics you serve, the calm is backed by plain-language physiology with citations, set in a technical monospace. No lotus, no purple, no superlatives — just stillness that reads as competence.
